description: Raw inputs of the LESSER cost accounting: paper Table 1, the Figure 1 bars, Appendix A.4 and Tables 5 to 8. Paths in 'files' are relative to data/cost/. 'referenced_not_shipped' lists code and data the timing jobs used that are not included here. python -m cost.table1 verifies every listed size and sha256 before computing.

pool_token_count.json.note: token counts of the 197,196-example pool for the Llama-2 and Llama-3.2 tokenizers; cost/pool_token_count.py reproduces both entries exactly

pool_token_count.log.source: console output of the token-count run
pool_token_count.log.note: progress output and the two result lines

sft_flops.json.source: output of the SFT FLOP computation
sft_flops.json.note: the computation behind the paper's SFT FLOP numbers; cost/sft_flops.py reproduces it to a relative 1e-12

timing_sft/timing.log.source: run directory of the SFT timing job
timing_sft/timing.log.note: stage start and end lines with exit codes and wall_seconds, the GPU, and the sha256 of the timed code

timing_sft/lesser_prefix.log.source: run directory of the SFT timing job
timing_sft/lesser_prefix.log.note: output of the LESSER extractor on the 10,000-example prefix

timing_sft/less_pi8.log.source: run directory of the SFT timing job
timing_sft/less_pi8.log.note: output of released LESS at projection interval 8 (the paper's LESS time)

timing_sft/less_pi16.log.source: run directory of the SFT timing job
timing_sft/less_pi16.log.note: output of released LESS at projection interval 16

timing_rl/timing.log.source: run directory of the RL timing job
timing_rl/timing.log.note: start and exit lines with exit codes, wall_seconds and scored groups for the three scorer variants

timing_rl/agreement.json.source: run directory of the RL timing job
timing_rl/agreement.json.note: ranking agreement between the scorer variants and the in-generation scores

timing_rl/prodsk.log.source: run directory of the RL timing job

timing_rl/prod.log.source: run directory of the RL timing job

timing_rl/sim.log.source: run directory of the RL timing job

timing_grace/timing.json.source: run directory of the GRACE timing job
timing_grace/timing.json.note: per-response times, peak memory and correctness cosines of the GRACE timing harness

timing_grace/grace_timing.log.source: log of the GRACE timing job
timing_grace/grace_timing.log.note: harness output: correctness checks and per-setting summary lines

released LESS extractor.note: representation/less/compute_less_embeds.py of github.com/dcml-lab/targeted-instruction-selection at commit 8ff397ad1c6e649465948a7ce847cb003140224c (Apache-2.0), unchanged; timed by the SFT timing job at projection interval 8; sha256 recorded in timing_sft/timing.log

released LESS extractor at projection in.note: the released LESS extractor with the default project_interval changed from 8 to 16, the only difference; sha256 recorded in timing_sft/timing.log

LESSER SFT extractor.note: LESSER SFT extractor timed by the SFT timing job; sha256 recorded in timing_sft/timing.log

LESSER SFT extractor, residual-feature m.note: module the LESSER SFT extractor imports; sha256 recorded in timing_sft/timing.log

LESS warmup checkpoint 316 of Llama-2-7B.note: LoRA adapter and Adam optimizer state that the timed LESS extraction loads

GradAlign scorer: select/parallel/prod_f.note: RL scorer code timed by the RL timing job; sha256 recorded in timing_rl/timing.log

GradAlign scorer: select/parallel/grpo_g.note: RL scorer code timed by the RL timing job; sha256 recorded in timing_rl/timing.log

GradAlign scorer: automated/run_parallel.note: RL scorer entry point timed by the RL timing job; sha256 recorded in timing_rl/timing.log

re-scored RL responses of one selection.note: the 81,920 candidate and 3,200 query responses that the RL timing job re-scored (681 MB); their summary.json has sha256 669496765b3954f38f98cea7289f5d0b755366340ed78aa954c41f6293121321

GRACE pipeline: GRACE/gradient_computati.note: GRACE pipeline module whose feature functions the GRACE timing harness timed; the job log records the first 16 hex digits

GRACE timing inputs (inputs.pt).note: token ids and stored ranking features of the 1,088 timed responses (12,853,286 bytes)
